_comment: Kav's bundled demo of picking takes. Ready-made images from the sample story Last Light: nothing is generated and nothing costs money. Open it with: python3 tools/review.py --demo

panels.line: Ruth climbing the lighthouse's spiral stairs in late-afternoon light, full body, one hand on the rail
panels.text: RUTH: Life in the last operating lighthouse on the Mediterranean can be demanding.

panels.line: Ruth reaching for a gauge that an automated green status lamp has already checked, frustrated close-up
panels.text: RUTH: Setting the beacon timing, for example, requires precision, skill and elegance.

panels.line: The family at the kitchen table: Babz reads an official letter aloud, Ruth stands tense, Imi marks a checklist
panels.text: BABZ: Today's the final date of manual operation. Tomorrow the Ministry of Automation takes control.
